integrity: The all-parameter conclusions follow from an explicit simplicial cover, a connected crown-graph intersection, homotopy-pushout splitting and integral Mayer-Vietoris. Finite script checks independently corroborate but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The full homotopy decomposition is nonequivariant, the integral group modules are established only for n>=5, quotient homology is asserted only over Q, and publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Complete open-neighborhood homotopy and symmetry of clique prisms
